verdict.rationale: Qodo's docs say it reviews against the full codebase, not just the diff (qodo-docs-22). They also describe a governance view of how repositories, services and teams connect so you can see a change's system-wide impact (qodo-docs-14), a live Software Map (qodo-docs-34), blast-radius risk classification (qodo-docs-25) and a Relevance section that surfaces related pull requests (qodo-docs-24). Together these suggest cross-repo awareness, but nothing shows multi-repo changes reviewed as one coherent unit or large-monorepo handling. Missing for 10: explicit coordinated review of changes split across several repositories, documented monorepo scale and performance support, depth on how cross-repo context feeds review findings, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
